title: Initial-code membership
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$ be a finite Boolean string, and let $s,u\in\mathbb{N}$. The pair encoding of $x$ with the pair encoding of the binary expansions of $u$ and $s$ belongs to the initial language of $N$.
hypotheses_covered: finite nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ over Boolean symbols
